pilot.sampling: sort SHA256(UTF8(str(seed)+'|'+unmodified frame_dir)); take8; no activity parsing or labels
pilot.raw_prediction: once per stride per sequence, same batch4 flipTTA as reconstructed V2

geometry.seams: union of internal starts and ends; displacement b-1 to b, exclude clip edges
geometry.local_jump: mean nonroot joint speed at seam / median of up to5 preceding and5 following speed frames, excluding seam; pelvis-relative in 2D/3D
geometry.nme: per-frame positive least-squares isotropic scale from root-relative H36M3D XY to official converted H36M2D XY; mean nonroot joint error / 2D joint-bbox diagonal; no rotation, no label or confidence weighting
geometry.bone_cv: population temporal std / mean for each of16 H36M tree bones; concatenate sequence-bone CVs
geometry.speed: per-frame mean nonroot Euclidean displacement / sequence median mean bone length; native-frame unit, no FPS conversion
geometry.aggregation: pool all frame NME/speed, all sequence-bone CVs and all seam counts; numpy linear percentiles
geometry.overlap_diagnostics: adjacent-window shared-frame pelvis-relative shape RMS, mean-bone scale ratio, shoulder/spine angles; diagnostic only

valid_support.source_frame: finite COCO->H36M XY bbox diagonal > epsilon; reject nonfinite input
valid_support.seam: all source frames in [max(0,b-1-radius),min(T,b+radius+1)) valid; do not shorten reference stencil
valid_support.nme: source-valid frames only, identical mask for saved V2 and every candidate
valid_support.full_timeline: 3D projection denominator, bones, speed, root remain unmasked
valid_support.coverage: report counts per sequence and aggregate; require nonempty aggregate evidence; no post-hoc cutoff

full.geometry_reference: all30 official OOD sequences, geometry only after pilot policy lock; never labels/classifier/selection
full.gate: same four geometry ratios versus saved V2; no policy reselection after full evaluation
full.sequence_cache: one float32 NTU25[T,25,3] array per sequence plus root/labels; runtime64/8 slices, no duplicate38GB materialization

newly_specified_not_recovered: precise local jump/reprojection/bone/speed formulas and aggregation
same batch4 avoids historical batch8 discrepancy; no relaxed reconciliation
full raw predictions retained for exact independent fusion audit
R2 geometry-only IO prevents DSTE/MotionAGFormer module collision; no metric/threshold change
R3 post-hoc source-only valid-support geometry evaluation; no frame/window removal or model/threshold changes
